To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) We present a novel machine learning based skyline detection method that can be applied on both natural and urban scenes.
(i) Machine learning based methods for skyline detection outperform the conventional methods in terms of accuracy and efficiency.
(i) We propose two novel machine/feature based skyline detection methods, one based on edges and the other on image patches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three main research questions.
the development of a machine learning based approach for mountainous skyline detection, which is robust to various environmental conditions.
the problem of mountainous skyline detection and visual geo localization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our machine learning based skyline detection methods can be used to improve the state of the art skyline detection methods for mountainous images and also can be used to develop robust geo localization methods for natural scenes, which is a challenging task.
we propose two novel skyline/horizon methods based on machine learning, which outperform the state of the art methods in both precision and recall.

our proposed machine learning based methods for mountainous skyline detection and visual geo localization outperform state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy, precision and recall, while also being more computationally efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed methods are able to outperform the conventional skyline/horizon approaches in terms of precision, recall and F1 score.

skyline/horizon is a natural feature for mountain images and can be used for mountainous geo localization, visual localization of UAV/MAVs in outdoor environments and for smooth navigation of MAVs.
